description.en: Finds files by name inside archives: zip, 7z, rar, tar.gz and more. Type the name in the search box, or zip and a space for archives only. Only the lists of files are read, in the background; nothing is unpacked
description.zh: 按文件名找压缩包里的文件：zip、7z、rar、tar.gz 等。直接在搜索框里输入名字就能搜到，或输入 zip 加空格只看压缩包里的。后台只读文件列表，不解压

notes.zh: 在 Windows 10 上闲着也会归还内存（#478）；系统内存紧张时先不归还（#471）。权限不变。
notes.en: Idle memory is given back on Windows 10 too (#478), and kept while Windows is short of it (#471). Permissions unchanged.
